svg.aria-label: MSVC rand(): the state is multiplied by 214013 and 2531011 is added; the draw is bits 16 to 30 of the new state. From srand(1), the first draws are 41, 18467, 6334, 26500 and 19169
svg.title: MSVC rand(): the state is multiplied by 214013 and 2531011 is added; the draw is bits 16 to 30 of the new state. From srand(1), the first draws are 41, 18467, 6334, 26500 and 19169
svg.text: state = state x 214013 + 2531011, then the draw is bits 16 to 30. Seeded with 1.
the 32-bit state after each step (bit 31 on the left)
A port must copy the formula, the seed, and the order of every draw. One extra draw shifts all the ones after it.
tools/triage/constants.py finds 214013 and the other generators' constants in a binary.
